english: speak no ill of the dead
also: say nothing but good about the dead

terms.comment: Usually traced to a Greek saying that Diogenes Laertius ascribes to Chilon. We have found no ancient Latin form; the Latin is modern.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
